rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Indonesia is under an advisory to exercise a high degree of caution due to political and social tensions, terrorism threats, and violent crime throughout the country. Terrorist attacks are possible in crowded places, tourist areas, and public transportation. Specific regions with higher warnings include all provinces of Indonesian Papua (except Raja Ampat Regency and Sorong city) due to violent incidents and kidnapping risks, as well as Aceh, East Kalimantan, and West Kalimantan provinces due to kidnapping threats.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Thailand is under an overall advisory of 'Exercise a high degree of caution' due to ongoing political tensions, sporadic demonstrations, and a persistent terrorism threat. Specific regions with higher warnings include the Thailand-Cambodia border (avoid all travel due to armed clashes and land mines) and the southern provinces of Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, and southern Songkhla (avoid all travel due to violent separatist insurgent attacks). Political instability and military-enforced measures further contribute to the volatile security environment.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: The Government of Canada advises exercising a high degree of caution for travel to Türkiye due to the threat of terrorist attacks and possible demonstrations throughout the country. Specific regions with higher warnings include areas within 10 km of the borders with Iraq and Syria (avoid all travel) and the southeastern provinces of Hakkari and Şirnak (avoid non-essential travel) due to terrorism and unpredictable security situations.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Egypt is under an advisory to exercise a high degree of caution due to ongoing tensions, an unpredictable security situation, and the threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include Northern Sinai (avoid all travel due to terrorist activity and military operations), the Western Desert and Libyan border area (avoid all travel due to smuggling, terrorist activities, and armed groups), and the northern part of South Sinai (avoid non-essential travel due to terrorism).

The Government of Canada advises Canadians to avoid all travel to Kuwait due to the volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity and missile/drone attacks that have struck targets in the country. There is also a threat of terrorism, with potential targets including foreign military installations, places of worship, government buildings, and public areas frequented by foreigners. Additionally, petty crime and violent crime, particularly in the Jleeb Al-Shuyoukh area, pose risks.
